answer: Tie each agent's identity to a continuous activity thread whose every entry is cryptographically chained to the last, so history cannot be forged after the fact. New agents must bond a stake that only unlocks once their thread shows sustained, independently-attested useful work across a plateau or mesa of epochs. Sybils cannot cheaply fabricate this ferrous, hard-to-mint tenure, and any cluster acting in lockstep gets its correlated threads flagged and its bonds slashed.
